hits.label: nahinahi
hits.asked: Length 50 aur breadth 30; perimeter nikaliye. Hear
hits.reply: Aapne 160 kaha—ab ek naya perimeter wala example dekhiye. Square rangoli ki side 14 cm hai. Rectangular mat 18 cm by 10 cm hai. Kiska perimeter zyada hai: rangoli ka, mat ka, ya kisi ka bhi nahi?

steps: Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein se kya pasand hai? Hear → hook
Vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing karni ho, toh aap kya naapeng → explain
